Fine subtle linework, smooth skin shading and softly blended gradients. Layered flowing hair with carefully drawn strands and delicate highlights. Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

In this cut her species shows in the outfit itself: its recognisable colours, shapes and parts. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

SCENE (chosen):

Outfit: a daring adult costume version of Altaria itself — white, blue colours; its cloud-like wings, short, hooked beak, prominent cheek patches, fluffy, white feathers rebuilt as costume pieces (ears or headband, hood, tail, gloves, fabric prints), never painted on her own skin, cut as a high-cut bodysuit with sheer thigh-high tights

LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.

overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; nothing slipped off; chest and pelvis covered

The costume must read at first glance as that creature's look, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit; she is a real woman in a costume — never the creature itself, its face on her face, fur or scales on her skin, a logo or readable text.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot.
